tools.description: Search the canonical AFRERA/EBDESIGN knowledge library using lexical, semantic, field and dependency-graph evidence.
Search the canonical 1,171-product North-East product master. Farmer MAP/floor prices remain redacted.
Execute a registered deterministic calculation with explicit basis, provenance and limitations. Never substitutes an LLM estimate for a formula.
Read the governed workflow/state-machine catalog including states, transitions, SLA metadata, approvals and source implementation.
Read the legacy/local medical coding-system inventory and integration status. This tool does not validate or finalize a medical code.
Read local clinical/nutrition/complementary-care context for drafting assistance. Output is legacy local knowledge and never a diagnosis, prescription or final code.

truthRules: Template availability does not imply a live model credential is configured.
Provider/model selection is runtime-configured and not hard-wired into business templates.
System instructions are not emitted by public catalog APIs; only prompt hashes and metadata are exposed.
Mutation tools require approval; current canonical tool set is read-only/deterministic.
Medical agent output is draft-only and requires qualified human review.
The legacy medical code search is not treated as authoritative terminology mapping.
